user.title: Connect to Nausto
user.description: Choose an area to find new sensors automatically, or follow the entire installation if it is only used on board. You can add individual entities from the list. Open Boat → Sensors in Nausto, add a data source and enter its eight-character code here, or paste a copied pairing code. Older codes still work. The code expires after ten minutes. Then return to Nausto to choose which sensors to follow and connect them to the right components. To control switches and lights, select them or a sensor on the same device from the list. Nausto never turns off a circuit with bilge pump or alarm in its name. A circuit with windlass, winch, propeller or thruster in its name is not listed and is never switched from Nausto.

init.title: Sensors for Nausto
init.description: Choose an area to find new sensors automatically, or follow the entire installation if it is only used on board. You can add individual entities from the list. Open Sensors in Nausto to choose which ones to follow, assign components and select primary sources. To control switches and lights, select them or a sensor on the same device from the list. Nausto never turns off a circuit with bilge pump or alarm in its name. A circuit with windlass, winch, propeller or thruster in its name is not listed and is never switched from Nausto.
